newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen says May same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen says May same-store sales up.

text.p: Walgreen Co said its May same-store sales rose eight percent.
Total May sales were $1.14 billion, up 13.4 percent from $1.01 billion for the same month in 1996, the retailer said.
Pharmacy sales, which account for 46 percent of overall sales, were up 19 percent, while same-store pharmacy sales rose 13.9 percent, Walgreen said.
Calendar year-to-date total sales were $5.58 billion, up 13.7 percent from $4.91 billion for the year-ago period.
Fiscal year-to-date sales for the nine months were $10.06 billion, up 13.6 percent from $8.86 billion. Same-store sales for the fiscal year to date rose 8.2 percent, Walgreen said.
As of May 31, Walgreen operated 2,289 drugstores in 34 states and Puerto Rico, versus 2,149 stores a year ago.
